action_space.continuous: Continuous action space - motor accepts float values [linear_factor, angular_factor] in range [-1, 1]
action_space.discrete: Discrete action space - motor accepts integer values 0-3 (up, down, left, right)

action_distribution.stochastic: Stochastic policy - sample from categorical distribution
action_distribution.deterministic: Deterministic policy - use argmax to select action
